statement: Let P_5((5)) be all permutations of [5] whose complete left-to-right list of interior pinnacle values is exactly (5), with endpoints excluded from peaks. Order this fiber by coordinatewise comparison of I_v(pi), the number of values smaller than v to the right of v. This nonempty induced poset is not a distributive lattice. An exact witness consists of e=12354, b=12534, a=13524, c=13452, d=13542. All five lie in the fiber, and their meets and joins computed among every element of the fiber satisfy b join c=d, a meet d=a, a meet b=b, a meet c=e, b join e=b, with a different from b. Thus a meet (b join c) differs from (a meet b) join (a meet c). This disproves the universal assertion asked in Liang--Sagan Question 8.6(a) in the published version, equivalently Question 8.7(a) of arXiv:2408.02782v1, including its explicitly qualified nonempty-fiber version. No assertion about counting part (b), minimality in n, or a classification of other fibers is submitted.
contribution: A five-permutation negative answer to the selected primary-source question, with a self-contained proof of the induced operations. The decisive internal meet follows from exactly four possible ambient lower inversion tables, of which only one has the required pinnacle list. Exact whole-fiber recomputation corroborates the proof. No equivalent resolution was found in the focused primary-source screen on 2026-09-14; this is a candidate for fresh mathematical and novelty assessment, not an acceptance or a claim of worldwide priority.
